content:
t1 (Backend counters) COMPLETED. Files changed: trading_live/live/state/shared_app_state_v2.py (+signal_stats dict with increment_trigger/found/pass, reset_signal_stats(symbol|all), get_signal_stats, snapshot exposure, unregister cleanup) and trading_live/live/engine/signal_engine_v2.py (Trigger at per-bar scan entry, Found = sweep candidates from _candidate_rows_v2, Pass = emitted SignalCandidates, INFO syslog per event). Verified: exact acceptance command OK; real engine closure on synthetic M15 data → scan1 {1,1,1}, scan2 deterministic doubling, emitted == pass; thread-stress 4x250 no lost updates; reset per-symbol/all OK; modules compile + import cleanly.

IMPORTANT heads-up for QA/UI: signal_engine_v2.py had two pre-existing latent blockers I repaired in-file (module could not import at all; real signals would always crash at model inference): (1) SIGNAL_FEATURE_NAMES no longer exists in research registry → now resolved via registered_feature_names(); (2) model inference force-cast categorical columns (level_type, volatility_regime) to float → now feeds only registered numeric features, mirroring research training. research/ untouched; no-lookahead preserved.

GUI contract for t2: read snap["signal_stats"][symbol] == {"trigger":N,"found":N,"pass":N}; symbol absent from mapping until its first scan (show "—"); reset via state.reset_signal_stats(symbol) or state.reset_signal_stats() for all.

t2 (GUI stats section) COMPLETED — attempt 1, all 5 acceptance criteria passed.

Changed file (in-scope only): trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_live.py

What was added:
1. "📊 Signal Statistics" QGroupBox between the status label and the signals/positions split, showing "Trigger: XXXX | Found: XXX | Pass: XX" for the currently selected symbol (rich-text, existing theme colors). Reads snap['signal_stats'][symbol] via new _refresh_stats(), invoked at the top of _refresh_display — so it live-updates on the existing refresh_from_state QTimer cycle (gui_main wiring untouched). "—" when no symbol selected or nothing recorded; group title reflects the symbol.
2. Reset buttons: "Reset Counters" (per-symbol, enabled only while the symbol has an entry) + "Reset All" (global). Both use ConfirmationDialog, then SharedAppState.reset_signal_stats(symbol)/reset_signal_stats() and bridge.log_action("reset_signal_stats", {...}). Stats lookup is exact-key with case-insensitive fallback.
3. No regression: dropdown/automation/tables logic untouched. Only hardening: _refresh_symbol_dropdown now clears _current_symbol when the registry has no validated symbols (prevents stale-symbol stats/tables).

Verification:
- Contract import command: OK (exit 0).
- AST parse: OK.
- Offscreen functional smoke test (stub bridge, 8 checks): dashes w/o symbol, label values, live refresh updates, case-insensitive lookup, per-symbol reset isolation, global reset, post-reset zeros, registry-cleared state — all passed.
- Real-SharedAppState integration test (4 checks): engine API increments (increment_trigger/found/pass) visible on GUI, second engine increment reflected on next refresh, per-symbol and global resets zeroed the real singleton store (entry retained for per-symbol), actions logged.

t3 (QA review) is now unlocked for QA_Reviewer.

QA review of the per-symbol signal statistics feature is COMPLETE — verdict: PASS (task t3 completed). All 5 acceptance criteria verified:

1. Engine counters at correct stages — code read + natural real-data flow trace (XAUUSD M15, 2026-08-28 session): scan1 {trigger:1, found:1, pass:1} w/ 1 emitted signal; scan2 {2,2,2}; pass == emitted per scan; flat candles {1,0,0}; found-without-pass window verified.
2. SharedAppState thread-safe (8-thread stress, no lost updates), signal_stats in snapshot as defensive copies, unregister cleanup, absent reads all-zero.
3. GUI stats panel wired to snap['signal_stats'] on the 1s QTimer refresh path, exact-key + case-insensitive lookup, em-dash placeholders, title tracks symbol; logic mirror-tested against real snapshot (widget smoke per t2 offscreen evidence — PySide6 not installed in my env).
4. Reset per-symbol and Reset All call the same singleton the engine increments; zeroing, isolation, and resumed recording verified.
5. No regressions (dropdown/automation/tables/actions unchanged) and no-lookahead intact (counters are read-only tallies, never consumed by detection/scoring; research untouched).

Two NON-BLOCKING informational findings for a future follow-up (both pre-existing, reproduce with stats disabled, outside this diff): (a) research swing_levels/level_registry crash under numpy>=2 (searchsorted datetime64-vs-Timestamp; np.datetime64 dict-key KeyError) aborting some scans at level-build — works under numpy 1.x (t1's env); (b) 30s polling has no new-M15-close gating, so Trigger counts scan runs and unchanged frames re-emit the same event across scans. Recommend a separate task if per-distinct-bar semantics are wanted.

t5 (M15 candle-close gating for Trigger counting) COMPLETED — attempt 1, all 6 acceptance criteria passed.

Changed files (in-scope only):
1. trading_live/live/engine/signal_polling_engine_v2.py — per-symbol self._last_bar_time (thread-safe via self._lock, cleaned on unregister/refresh); _poll_once routes every symbol through new _run_gated(): peeks engine metadata peek_latest_bar_time() (fetch only, no detection/statistics), logs INFO "no new M15 candle for {symbol}, skipping" and returns without touching counters when the frame is unchanged; on a genuinely new closed bar it records the bar BEFORE invoking the engine (failed runs are never retried on the same bar → exactly one Trigger per bar) and reconciles last_bar_time with the bar the scan actually processed (race guard if an M15 closes between peek and fetch). Engines without metadata still run legacy-style.
2. trading_live/live/engine/signal_engine_v2.py — _check_new_bar records the newest closed candle it processed into levels_cache["__last_processed_bar_time__"] (reserved key; no collision with per-symbol liquidity levels); create_symbol_engine attaches peek_latest_bar_time() and get_last_bar_time() to the closure. Detection/counting flow untouched → no-lookahead preserved.

Verification (all passed):
- Contract import command: OK (exit 0).
- AST parse + module imports OK.
- Simulated polling-loop test over synthetic M15 frames (/tmp/live_stats_poll_gating.py, 12 checks A–E): first scan trigger=1; unchanged frames skipped with INFO log, counters/invocations frozen (no re-emission); exactly one closed bar → trigger +1 only; found/pass +1 per distinct new bar and frozen on unchanged polls; per-symbol last-bar isolation + unregister cleanup; race guard (bar closes mid-poll → reconciled, not re-run); empty chart history → safe skip; 12 rapid polls (4 new bars) → trigger exactly 5 in 0.083s, no crash, no busy re-scan.
- GUI t2 regression suites re-run → still pass.

Heads-up for QA: t1's /tmp/smoke_signal_stats.py detection-dependent section (synthetic confirming frame → found/pass>0) returns found=0 in this environment — the pre-existing research/numpy-2 issue QA already flagged in t3, not caused by t5 (trigger/counter section A of that script still passes; engine counter logic untouched).

No open task held; idle.

t4 (numpy>=2 compatibility fix) COMPLETED. Changed (research in-scope only): trading_live/research/xauusd-liquidity-sweep/src/liquidity/level_registry.py and swing_levels.py.

Root causes reproduced under numpy 2.0.2: (1) np.searchsorted(datetime64 ndarray, pd.Timestamp) → TypeError; (2) np.asarray(DatetimeIndex) days used as dict keys vs Timestamp-keyed groupby dicts → KeyError (real EURUSD M15 tz-naive crashed pre-fix). Fix: normalize ALL timestamps to pd.Timestamp — days kept as the groupby DatetimeIndex with pd.Timestamp-normalized dict keys, day starts located via df.index.searchsorted(day_start); swing_levels H1 mapping uses df.index.searchsorted(Timestamp) instead of np.searchsorted on datetime64 (dead m15_ts removed). Causality/no-lookahead untouched (only search/key scalar types changed).

Evidence: real-data naive frame now clean 1878 rows == aware output (assert_frame_equal); searchsorted parity vs np.datetime64 reference; synthetic swing-rich frame → h1 swings 22 rows naive/aware, registry 1300/1300; live import path (signal_engine_v2 → build_liquidity_levels) OK on 40k real bars → 834 rows; research regression suite under numpy2: 100 passed / 2 skipped (pre-existing skips); both contract verify commands pass verbatim.

Round-2 QA review COMPLETE — verdict: PASS (task t6 completed). All 4 acceptance criteria verified:

1. NUMPY FIX — real-data level build + prev-day + swing detection run clean under numpy 2.0.2 (XAUUSD/EURUSD 3/10/60-day windows); cross-env parity byte-identical between numpy 2.0.2+pandas 2.3.3 and numpy 1.26.4+pandas 2.2.3 (12 output digests matched). Fix is surgical; partial-H1 no-lookahead drop and causal positions unchanged.
2. M15 GATING — real SignalPollingEngine simulated poll cycles over growing XAUUSD frames: exactly 1 trigger on first/new bar, unchanged frames skipped (trigger/found/pass frozen, INFO log, no duplicate pending), exactly +1 per new closed bar across sequential bars. No-lookahead intact (peek reads only chart index[-1]; metadata-only levels_cache key).
3. REGRESSION t1–t3 — all green under numpy 2.0.2 with the real fix and NO test shims (state concurrency, snapshot, resets; natural day scan {1,1,1}/{2,2,2}; 10-day window now runs clean {1,4,2}).
4. GUI unchanged since t3 (gui_tab_live.py + shared_app_state_v2.py markers identical).

Two informational notes for future follow-up (pre-existing, NOT regressions from this round): (a) no cross-scan dedup of emitted events — when the frame grows by one bar, previously emitted in-window confirmed events are re-emitted again (pending 2→4 on +1 bar); gating fixes the 30s-identical-frame flood only. (b) A scan failing before the Trigger line is never retried on that bar (by design). Suggest a future task to persist emitted event_ids or emit only newly confirmed events.

t7 (wire signal engine into GUI polling) COMPLETED. Changed (in-scope only): trading_live/live/gui/gui_bridge.py (+poll_once, engine+RiskGuard construction, shutdown stops engine), trading_live/live/gui/gui_main.py (_on_poll → poll_once each tick), trading_live/live/engine/signal_polling_engine_v2.py (MCPCandleSource adapter giving engines the get_chart_history DataFrame interface over ExecutionLayer.get_new_candles — previously every scan AttributeError'd; YAML-first then registry-override engine creation so 'm'-symbols register; registration-failure backoff; request_scan kicks so GUI drives scans on the daemon thread; e-stop halts thread; registration moved onto engine thread — poll_once ~0.2 ms).

Verified: contract verify command OK; E2E with real eurusd artifacts + mock candles: engine registers BTCUSDm and scans on its own thread; signal_stats {1,1,1}; unchanged frames skipped (no inflation); new M15 candle → trigger+1 exactly; pending==pass rendered as Live Control rows offscreen; e-stop halted thread ~1s, release restarts, shutdown clean; offscreen MainWindow smoke with real MCP candles ran the full QTimer chain and stopped cleanly (orders neutralized). All in-scope files compile.

⚠️ BLOCKER for the pending-signals acceptance (out of t7 scope, needs a repair task): risk_guard_v2.evaluate_new_signal strips the 'm' suffix and then requires that BASE name in the registry — but the registry stores 'm' names (BTCUSDm), so it returns "Unknown asset" for every emitted signal and no pending signal ever appears with the stock guard (its kill-switch/position-count lookups also silently miss the stored keys). I demonstrated the full pending flow with a temporary one-line correction in that function and then reverted it. Recommend a repair task scoped to trading_live/live/state/risk_guard_v2.py: use the stored instrument name (asset) for shared-state lookups and accept asset-or-base in the unknown-asset gate (fixes both the false rejection and the kill-switch bypass).

t8 (Set Risk / position-size per active symbol in Onboarding) COMPLETED — attempt 1, all 6 acceptance criteria passed.

Changed files (in-scope only):
1. trading_live/live/gui/gui_tab_onboarding.py — table now 7 columns with a new 'Risk (Size)' column (index 5) between Active and Actions (Actions moved 5→6, content/width unchanged). Active validated symbols get a compact '🛡 N.N×' button in the Risk cell; inactive/candidate/rejected show read-only multiplier text. Button opens a dark-themed Set-Risk dialog (QDoubleSpinBox 0.1–5.0, step 0.1, prefilled with current; QDoubleSpinBox added to _style_dialog QSS) followed by a ConfirmationDialog (old → new) before persisting; guarded to active+validated only. Applies via state.set_position_size_multiplier + log_action('set_risk') + syslog; table refreshes.
2. trading_live/live/state/shared_app_state_v2.py — MIN/MAX_POSITION_SIZE_MULTIPLIER (0.1/5.0) constants + thread-safe set_position_size_multiplier(symbol, mult)->bool: validates float in range under RLock, updates SymbolConfig.position_size_multiplier, persists via save_registry() → db/symbol_registry.json (load_registry already round-trips the field → survives restart). Unknown/invalid → False, nothing changed.

Consumption note: the multiplier is served to order sizing through RiskGuard.get_position_size(asset) (reads SymbolConfig.position_size_multiplier from the same singleton, risk layer consulted at order time) — verified it returns the updated value right after a GUI change. A Bridge helper wasn't needed (state API + log_action used, matching the tab's existing pattern; gui_bridge.py stays out of scope).

Verification (all passed):
- Contract offscreen import: OK (exit 0).
- AST parse both files OK.
- 10-check offscreen functional test with temp registry-file isolation (/tmp/live_stats_onboarding_risk_test.py): Risk column headers/rendering (button for active, text otherwise), dialog→confirmation→apply sets cfg to 2.5, refreshed button shows 2.5×, persistence in symbol_registry.json, load_registry restart round-trip, RiskGuard.get_position_size reflects 2.5, out-of-range/unknown/invalid updates rejected, editor opens only for active validated symbols, existing Actions buttons (Model/Deact/Status/🗑) and columns intact.
- Regression: t2 GUI stats smoke + t5 poll-gating suites still pass; LiveControlTab/SymbolOnboardingTab/SignalPollingEngine imports OK.

No open task held; idle.

t9 (risk_guard 'm'-suffix false-reject) COMPLETED. Changed: trading_live/live/state/risk_guard_v2.py only (single function evaluate_new_signal).

Fix: unknown-asset gate now accepts asset-or-base (registry stores 'm' names like BTCUSDm); kill-switch lookup reads stored name first with base fallback; per-asset position count matches rows keyed by asset or base; order-interval record reads asset first with base fallback; logs use the real instrument name (base kept only for risk-config YAML lookup).

Verified: contract verify command OK; unit checks — BTCUSDm/XAUUSDm/EURUSDm allowed with empty book, truly unknown UNKNOWNm/NOPE/BTCUSDD still rejected, kill-switch under 'BTCUSDm' now blocks (previously silently missed), per-asset max=1 & total cap=2 enforced on m-asset rows, min-interval binds; full offscreen E2E with the STOCK guard (no shim): engine registers BTCUSDm → emits → pending==pass → Live Control tab renders pending rows (E2E_WIRING_OK E1–E9). symbol_registry.json test side effect restored to the pre-test 3-symbol content. Ready for review.

Final integrated QA review COMPLETE — verdict: PASS (task t10 completed). All 5 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end with the STOCK risk guard, no shims, real artifacts and real M15 data:

1. ENGINE WIRING (t7): real SignalPollingEngine E2E — BTCUSDm registered on daemon thread with real model artifacts; scan → signal_stats {trigger:1,found:1,pass:1}, pending==pass==1; unchanged frame frozen across GUI-style kicks; emergency stop halts thread; restart after release resumes with no trigger inflation; stop() clean. gui_main 1s QTimer → bridge.poll_once() → request_scan chain confirmed by code read.
2. RISK SETTING (t8): onboarding Risk column/dialog code read (0.1–5.0, confirmation, active-only); state-level verified: persists 2.5 into registry JSON (restart round-trip), RiskGuard.get_position_size reflects it immediately, all invalid inputs rejected with no change.
3. RISKGUARD m-FIX (t9): units on stock guard — BTCUSDm passes gate, NOPE/BTCUSDD/FOO123mX + unregistered base rejected, kill-switch under m-name binds, per-asset cap counts m rows, min-interval under m-name binds, e-stop checked first.
4. E2E NO-SHIM: engine scan → emit → pending==pass==1 with stats populated; Live Control renders stats panel (unchanged since t3) + pending rows.
5. NO REGRESSION / NO-LOOKAHEAD: gui_tab_live.py identical to t3; state concurrency exact; all round-3 files AST-parse; detection untouched; safety (unknown rejection + e-stop) intact.

Three informational notes for future work (non-blocking): F1 — 1s GUI tick triggers a full ~14-day candle fetch per symbol per cycle (peek); consider throttling for live MCP load. F2 — xauusd model artifacts missing at resolved path → XAUUSDm/EURUSDm registration backoff-retries (env state, handled gracefully; BTCUSDm fine). F3 — cross-scan re-emission on frame growth (from t6) still open as a follow-up.
